p.write_text('<?php mb_regex_encoding("UTF-8"); var_dump(mb_ereg("(?:()|())*\\2", "")); ?>')

 {"step":1,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/bug72399.phpt","function":"<global>","line":9,"var":"mb_ereg_search_init pattern","code":"$var5 = mb_ereg_search_init(\"\",\"2\");","note":"The mbstring extension accepts attacker-controlled regex patterns and passes them into the bundled Oniguruma compiler."},
 {"step":2,"file":"oniguruma/src/regint.h","function":"<global>","line":63,"var":"USE_STUBBORN_CHECK_CAPTURES_IN_EMPTY_REPEAT","code":"#define USE_STUBBORN_CHECK_CAPTURES_IN_EMPTY_REPEAT","note":"This build enables the empty-repeat capture-check logic that reaches quantifier emptiness classification."},
 {"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5457,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"A quantified body with zero minimum length triggers recursive emptiness analysis of the regex AST."},
 {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"switch (NODE_TYPE(node)) {","note":"The analysis recursively traverses attacker-controlled nodes such as ALT, QUANT, BAG_MEMORY, and CALL."},
 {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4935,"var":"NODE_BODY(node)","code":"if (NODE_IS_RECURSION(node)) { return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC; }","note":"Recursive memory/capture constructs are classified specially, matching the vulnerable control-flow path in the report."},
 {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"compile_quant_body_with_empty_check","line":1051,"var":"emptiness","code":"else if (emptiness == BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_REC) r = add_op(reg, OP_EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST_PUSH);","note":"The emptiness classification influences emitted code and later dereferences captured memory state during compilation."},
 {"step":7,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_variation7.phpt","function":"<global>","line":20,"var":"pattern '(?:()|())*\\2'","code":"var_dump(mb_ereg($regex_ascii, $string_ascii, $regs_ascii));","note":"A crafted pattern with an empty alternation under a quantifier and a backreference drives the compiler into the vulnerable quantifier analysis path."}
]
Path('candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
